Si.what: diamond silicon -- the canonical band-structure benchmark
Si.why: the VASP wiki's own bandstructure example; insulator, 2 atoms

Al.what: fcc aluminium -- the canonical free-electron metal
Al.why: no gap at all; catches a tool that assumes a semiconductor, and exercises the smearing path (ISMEAR must not be tetrahedron-only)

MgO.what: rocksalt MgO -- the canonical wide-gap ionic insulator
MgO.why: a large gap PBE still underestimates badly; the opposite extreme from Al in the same 2-atom cell

Fe.what: bcc iron -- the canonical itinerant ferromagnet
Fe.why: a tool that drops ISPIN or MAGMOM gets 0 instead of 2.2 muB, and the energy is wrong by ~0.5 eV/atom. One atom, seconds to run

NiO.what: rocksalt NiO in the AFM-II ordering -- the canonical DFT+U case
NiO.why: PBE makes it a metal; PBE+U opens a gap. The reference case for everything this toolkit does with U, magnetism and AFM ordering
